description: Source code for a configurable RSSI LED control daemon for OpenWrt, managing LED indicators based on Wi-Fi quality metrics.

classes.name: led
classes.description: Represents an LED with sysfs path, control file descriptor, and current state.

classes.name: rule
classes.description: Defines rules for LED behavior based on Wi-Fi quality thresholds.

methods.name: log_rules
methods.description: Logs the current set of rules to syslog.

methods.name: init_led
methods.description: Initializes an LED by opening sysfs control file and setting initial brightness.

methods.name: close_led
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with an LED.

methods.name: quality
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi quality percentage using iwinfo.

methods.name: open_backend
methods.description: Opens iwinfo backend for Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: update_leds
methods.description: Updates LEDs based on current Wi-Fi quality and rules.
